promptFragments.description: Reusable prompt text blocks derived from the base shot definition. These should be used by the prompt builder while generating final image-generation prompts.

positive.description: Positive prompt fragments that describe what must be present in the image.

body_coverage: Model visible from top of head to feet
Model visible from head to toe
Model visible from head to mid-thigh
Model visible from head to waist
Model visible from shoulder to waist
Model visible from waist to feet
Model visible from hip to feet
Model visible from knees to feet
view_direction: Model facing directly toward the camera
Model facing away from the camera
Model shown in three-quarter front view
Model shown in three-quarter back view
Torso facing away from the camera
camera_and_framing: Camera positioned directly in front of the model
Camera positioned directly behind the model
Camera angle remains neutral and undistorted
No upward or downward camera tilt
Small breathing room above the head
Small breathing room below the shoes
garment_visibility: Entire outfit including footwear fully visible
Front of all garments clearly visible
Back of all garments clearly visible
Full silhouette of all layered garments clearly readable
Fit and garment proportions clearly visible
Layering relationship between garments clearly visible
pose: Arms relaxed naturally at the sides
One hand may hold a prop
Hands must not obscure key garment areas
composition: Model and outfit remain the visual focus

negative.description: Negative prompt fragments that describe what must not appear or happen in the image.

wrong_crop: Do not crop the garment hem
Do not crop key garment details
Do not let the model fill the frame edge to edge
wrong_view: Do not rotate the model into a side view
Do not rotate the model into a back view
Do not rotate the model into a front view
Do not change the required view direction
Do not use three-quarter view unless required
Do not hide the garment front
Do not hide the garment back
Do not obscure the side profile
Do not turn the face away from the camera when face visibility is required
Do not show the face when face visibility is forbidden
wrong_camera: Do not use upward camera tilt
Do not use downward camera tilt
Do not use extreme low-angle perspective
Do not use extreme high-angle perspective
Do not use dramatic cinematic perspective
Do not use off-center camera placement
Do not use diagonal camera framing
wrong_pose: Do not use aggressive posing that obscures garments
Do not use leaning pose that distorts garment visibility
Do not cross arms over the garment
Do not cover the neckline with hands
Do not hide the waistband with hands
Do not hide the hemline with hands
Do not hide footwear with stance
Do not use stiff robotic posture
Do not use overly dramatic fashion pose
garment_obstruction: Do not obscure the garment front
Do not obscure the garment back
Do not obscure the full silhouette
Do not let props hide the garment
Do not let hair cover key garment details
Do not let arms cover key garment areas
Do not let bags cover key garment areas
composition_errors: Do not use a distracting background
Do not use a busy background
Do not use dark cluttered background
Do not use props that dominate the frame
Do not place the model too close to frame edges
Do not create unequal side spacing unless specified
Do not use harsh editorial lighting
Do not make the outfit secondary to the scene
quality_errors: Do not create unrealistic fabric drape
Do not generate asymmetrical garment errors unless part of the design

strictRules.description: Non-negotiable rules that must be preserved when this base shot definition is used. These should survive client overrides and preset composition unless explicitly approved.

shot_identity_rules: The shot must remain a full-body front-facing shot.
The shot must remain a full-body back-facing shot.
The shot must remain an upper-half shot.
The shot must remain a lower-half shot.
The shot must remain a side-view shot.
The shot must remain a three-quarter-view shot.
The shot must remain a close-up detail shot.
The shot must preserve the base shot family.
The shot must preserve the required body coverage.
The shot must preserve the required view direction.
framing_rules: The frame must include the full body from head to shoes.
The frame must include the upper body according to the shot definition.
The frame must include the lower body according to the shot definition.
The frame must include the required crop boundaries.
The frame must not crop any required body part.
The frame must not crop any required garment zone.
The subject must remain centered unless the shot definition allows otherwise.
The image must preserve the required portrait orientation.
The required breathing room must be preserved.
The model must not fill the frame edge to edge.
view_rules: The model must face directly toward the camera.
The model must face away from the camera.
The model must remain in side profile.
The model must remain in three-quarter view.
The face must not be visible.
The torso direction must match the base shot definition.
The leg direction must match the base shot definition.
The front of the garment must remain visible.
The back of the garment must remain visible.
The side profile of the garment must remain visible.
camera_rules: The camera must not tilt upward.
The camera must not tilt downward.
The camera must not use fisheye distortion.
The camera must not use extreme perspective distortion.
The camera distance must match the required shot coverage.
The camera position must match the required view direction.
garment_visibility_rules: The complete outfit silhouette must be readable.
The required garment zones must be visible.
The garment front must be clearly visible.
The garment back must be clearly visible.
The sleeve shape must be visible.
The trouser break must be visible.
The footwear must be fully visible.
Layered garments must remain visually readable.
Fit and garment proportions must remain readable.
Accessories must not obscure required garment zones.
pose_rules: The pose must not obscure required garment zones.
The pose must preserve the garment silhouette.
The arms must not block important garment details.
The hands must not cover required product areas.
The legs must not hide footwear when footwear visibility is required.
The body must not twist away from the required view direction.
The stance must support clear product visibility.
The pose must remain commercially clean.
background_rules: The background must remain clean and neutral.
The background must not distract from the outfit.
The model and garment must remain the visual focus.
Shadows must not hide garment details.
product_integrity_rules: The product color must not change.
The product pattern must not change.
The product silhouette must not change.
The product length must not change.
The product fit must not change.
The product material appearance must remain realistic.
The generated image must not invent extra product layers.
The generated image must not remove required product layers.

promptWeight.description: Optional priority configuration used when merging base shot definition fragments with client shot definitions, presets, and job-level instructions.

priority.description: How important the base shot prompt fragments are during prompt merge.

mergeStrategy.description: How the prompt builder should combine this base shot prompt with client, preset, and job-level prompt content.

conflictResolution.description: What should happen when prompt fragments conflict with client definitions or presets.

positiveWeight.description: Numeric weight for positive fragments. Suggested range: 0.0 to 1.0.

negativeWeight.description: Numeric weight for negative fragments. Suggested range: 0.0 to 1.0.

strictRulesWeight.description: Numeric weight for strict rules. In most production cases this should be 1.

lockedFragmentTypes.description: Prompt fragment groups that cannot be overridden by client or preset configuration.

overrideableFragmentTypes.description: Prompt fragment groups that client definitions or presets may override.
